publication_metadata.title: Could We Build an Entire City That Floats?
publication_metadata.credits: No third-party photographs or drawings; the 3D models and diagrams are made for this video. Narration and any sound effects are credited in review/YOUTUBE_DESCRIPTION.md
publication_metadata.disclosure: Narration: AI-generated voice (Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0; voice am_michael) - in the description
publication_metadata.summary: 10,000 people, with homes, schools, a clinic, parks and streets to walk along, and not one of them standing on land. Could we design a city like this, one that floats, stays where we put it and keeps working? This film treats it as a design problem and solves it one step at a time: making buildings float, joining platforms into a city, water that never stays still, keeping the city in place, the services a city needs, and what changes out at sea.
disclosures: 3D models and diagrams are illustrative visualisations made for this video, not engineering designs.
The district, its platforms and the numbers given as estimates come from the Studio's own concept-level calculations for this video, not from a certified engineering design.
The motion of the water and the platforms is a conceptual visualisation, not a hydrodynamic simulation.
